_readme: The catalogue. One entry per product; the `slug` must not change (it is the product’s web address and the key the cart and the backend use). Copy is lifted from the pouch labels. Prices and shipping rates are placeholders until Pratiti signs off — change the numbers, not the keys.

products.name: Paneer Paratha
products.tagline: Press heavier and recover smarter with our push-day-ready paneer paratha.
products.description: A classic Punjabi flatbread stuffed with spiced, protein-rich paneer. Made to be eaten like a real meal, not a supplement — and tracked like one.

gallery.alt: Push Day Paneer Paratha pouch held up mid-flex
Paneer paratha pouch on turf with a dumbbell
Paneer paratha pouch on the track
Founder lying on the track beside a paneer paratha pouch
Paneer paratha on the yard line
Founder flexing with the paneer paratha pouch

products.ingredients: Whole wheat flour, paneer (milk, citric acid), onion, green chilli, coriander, ginger, cumin, garam masala, ajwain, salt, oil.

reviews.title: Sunday paratha, push-day macros
reviews.quote: Tastes like the one my mum makes on a Sunday, except it has 30 grams of protein and I ate it in the car after chest day.
reviews.name: Aarav M.

reviews.title: Pan-warm it. Trust me.
reviews.quote: Ninety seconds on the tawa and the paneer goes soft again. Microwave works when I’m late but the pan is the real thing.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.title: Filling. Almost too filling.
reviews.quote: One paratha is a full lunch. Four stars only because I want a two-pack for the days I train twice.
reviews.name: Daniel K.

products.name: Rotli & Shaak
products.tagline: Set a new personal record starting with lunch.
products.description: Soft, tofu-based pr-otein rotlis paired with our Chin-Up Chana Bataka Shaak. The Gujarati home plate, rebuilt for training days.

gallery.alt: Rotli pouch handed off on the track
Rotli pouch and shaak tub on turf with dumbbells
Rotli pouch at the tennis net
Rotli pouch, shaak tub and dumbbell on the field
Founder on the track with rotli and shaak
Rotli and shaak tubs packed in a cooler

products.ingredients: Rotli: whole wheat flour, tofu (soybeans, water, calcium sulphate), oil, salt. Shaak: chana (chickpeas), bataka (potato), tomato, onion, ginger, garlic, turmeric, cumin, coriander, red chilli, salt, oil.

reviews.title: The home plate, portable
reviews.quote: Rotli and shaak in a foil pack that fits my gym bag. It’s the plate I grew up with and it logs straight into MyFitnessPal.
reviews.name: Nisha P.

reviews.title: Soft rotli from frozen
reviews.quote: I didn’t believe a tofu rotli would stay soft. Between paper towels in the microwave it comes out like fresh.
reviews.name: Marcus L.

reviews.title: Shaak carries it
reviews.quote: The chana bataka shaak is the star. I’d happily buy a tub of it on its own.
reviews.name: Sanjana R.

products.name: Thepla
products.tagline: Fuel your leg day one bite at a time.
products.description: A macro-tracked take on a classic Gujarati wholewheat and fenugreek flatbread. Savoury, portable, and built for the days that hurt.

gallery.alt: Thepla pouch on turf with a dumbbell and phone
Three thepla pouches on the blacktop
Thepla pouch beside a dumbbell on the yard line
Founder sitting on the track with thepla and paneer paratha
Founder on the track with a thepla pouch
Thepla pouch and dumbbell on the field

products.ingredients: Whole wheat flour, fenugreek leaves (methi), yoghurt, turmeric, red chilli, cumin, sesame, ginger, garlic, salt, oil.

reviews.title: Leg-day fuel, no crash
reviews.quote: Two thepla an hour before squats and nothing sits heavy. Savoury, warm, done in a minute.
reviews.name: Rohan D.

reviews.title: Travels anywhere
reviews.quote: Took a pack to a track meet, warmed them at the hotel. Still tasted like methi, not like cardboard.
reviews.name: Elena V.

reviews.title: Wish I’d ordered more
reviews.quote: Ate the pack in two days. That’s the review.
reviews.name: Jay T.
